release.headline: Subshell 1.0 release candidate 2: the Update button in the update dialog now updates the app
highlights: The "subshell update available" dialog now has an Update button that downloads and installs the update inside the app. Before, it only led to the GitHub page.
Everything else is the same as 1.0 release candidate 1 and 0.92. If Update or What's new does not work for you, tell us on r/subshell or GitHub.
